metadata.method: Média simples dos percentuais do local mais próximo atribuídos aos setores; universo de renda fixo antes das exclusões.
metadata.income_definition: Rendimento nominal médio mensal dos responsáveis pelos domicílios do setor (V06004), Censo 2022; salários mínimos de 2022 (R$ 1.212).
metadata.denominator: Soma dos votos nominais e de legenda do cargo/local, excluídos os códigos especiais 95/96/97
metadata.vote_status_note: O arquivo de votação por seção não certifica sozinho a situação jurídica dos votos; os denominadores devem ser reconciliados com os totais oficiais.

vote_audit.method: 2018 official all-or-zero candidate validity and integral explicit party conversion; exact valid/nominal/party totals and COMBINED NULL PLUS ANNULLED nonvalid ledger (section96 plus excluded nominal/party ballots) per zone. Official null and annulled components retained separately; their computed individual allocation is NOT inferred. Annulled extension restricted to Senate; pending category blocked; separate category independently audited; no allocation; Explicit party-zone legend/conversion aggregates counted once per transit partition; coalition descriptor repeats must agree; original nominal rows retained separately; Observed section97 exactly matches the official separately counted annulled category in every zone; excluded separately, NEVER added to nulls; pending category remains blocked; Disputes isolated by ordinary election ID, round and office; blocked disputes explicitly unavailable

spatial.method: Nearest contemporary polling place to interior tract point, same 2022 municipality
